title: surge.dem omits the frozen spec's mid-run capacity fix and resolve — the event-stream golden never pins Crisis_Resolved, leaving the resolve/re-trigger half of the lifecycle unpinned in the golden layer (spec change log records no such narrative change)
evidence:
_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-4-2-surge-crisis.md:33 (frozen) — "**Golden:** NEW `demos/surge.dem` (unprepared narrow-pipe fan: trigger @window start, a mid-run capacity fix, resolve after the window ends); the event-stream golden pins `Crisis_Triggered{Surge}` at the exact tick within the scheduled window."

spec:141 (Design Notes) — "`surge.dem` = narrow-pipe host→router→res (unprepared; saturated at base demand). `Crisis_Triggered` lands at the window's first tick (20 arrivals → 6 join the bound lane → saturated); a parallel wide drawn mid-run pools into the same bundle (the fix); the queue drains after the window ends (base demand 2/tick ≤ 2.67 service) → `Crisis_Resolved` at the exact drain tick — read from the run, pinned in the demo comment + tests."

demos/surge.dem:9-15 — "The crisis stays ACTIVE through the window AND beyond (base demand keeps the bottleneck saturated — the player never fixed it; the banner + red bottleneck outline persist: honest)." ... "# 170000ms = post-window, the banner persists (the flaw was never fixed)."

demos/surge.dem:19-21 — the only logged commands are "at 100ms draw 0 1 narrow" / "at 100ms draw 1 2 narrow" (no fix, no demolish, no Crisis_Resolved anywhere in the run)
detail: The shipped demo re-authors the frozen golden narrative: no capacity fix, no queue drain, so Crisis_Resolved never fires and no golden (T1/event-stream/PNG) pins the resolve path the frozen spec explicitly required ('Crisis_Resolved at the exact drain tick — pinned in the demo comment + tests'). Only core unit tests cover resolve; the spec change log does not record this deviation.
recommended_fix: Either add the mid-run wide-pipe fix so the golden pins trigger + resolve ticks as the frozen spec describes, or record the narrative change in the spec change log with the golden-coverage rationale.
